units.The visuals are bright, fast and full-sc: The visuals are bright, fast and full-screen, and they can flash. A small number of people can have a seizure when they see flashing lights or patterns, even with no history of epilepsy. The app limits how far and how fast its own effects change the brightness and follows Android's "Remove animations" setting, but it cannot make the visuals safe for everyone. If you or anyone watching is sensitive to flashing light, do not use the visuals, and stop at once if you feel unwell.

units.Does it need the internet or an account?: Does it need the internet or an account?
No account, ever. The app works offline. The internet is used only for Cast to TV and for showing the visual on a computer, over your own Wi-Fi. The Google Cast component sends Google anonymous usage logs; the privacy policy explains this.

units.The visuals are bright, fast and full-sc: The visuals are bright, fast and full-screen, and they can flash. A small number of people can have a seizure when they see flashing lights or patterns, even with no history of epilepsy. The app limits how far and how fast its own effects may change the brightness, and it follows Android's "Remove animations" setting, but it does not measure the finished picture, and .milk presets only get a brightness cap: the flashes they draw themselves are not limited. It cannot make the visuals safe for everyone. If you or anyone watching is sensitive to flashing light, do not use the visuals, and stop at once if you feel unwell.
